q: The documentary was deliberately provocative: it was designed to provoke viewers to question assumptions they had long accepted. Which explanation is most accurate?
o: provocative means thought-provoking or controversial, and provoke viewers to question means prompt them to question
provoke always means make someone angry

exp.trans: 这部纪录片有意具有挑衅性/引发思考：它就是为了促使观众质疑自己长期接受的假设。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The documentary（主语）+ was（系动词）+ deliberately provocative（表语）。冒号后：it（主语）+ was designed（被动谓语）+ to provoke viewers to question...（目的）。provoke viewers to question是provoke sb to do结构；they had long accepted修饰assumptions。
exp.other: documentary 纪录片；deliberately 有意地；assumption 假设/想当然的看法；accept 接受。
exp.meaning: provocative在文章、观点、作品语境中常表示会引发争议或思考；provoke sb to do 可表示促使、激起某人去做某事，不一定是“激怒”。
exp.rest: sexually attractive是某些人物/服装语境中的另一义，不能解释question assumptions；always make someone angry把一种义项扩大成唯一义项；completely objective讨论客观程度，原文没有提供这种判断，provocative本身也不等于不客观。

q: A difficult expedition may be exhausting day by day yet feel deeply rewarding years later. In this sense, happiness is being treated as a “past-tense condition.” What does that mean?
o: happiness can only exist in childhood
happiness is judged retrospectively rather than only by moment-to-moment pleasure
people should ignore all present emotions
past events are always happier than present ones

exp.trans: 一次艰苦的探险每天可能都很累，但多年后回想起来却非常值得。在这个意义上，把幸福视为“过去时的状态”，就是强调幸福可以通过事后的回顾来判断，而不只看当下每一刻是否快乐。
exp.structure: 第一句：A difficult expedition（主语）+ may be exhausting... yet feel deeply rewarding...（并列谓语部分），yet连接当时疲惫与事后满足的对比。第二句happiness + is being treated（现在进行时的被动谓语）+ as a past-tense condition。past-tense在这里是比喻性的时间视角。
exp.other: expedition 探险；exhausting 令人疲惫的；rewarding 值得的/有回报的；retrospectively 回顾性地。
exp.meaning: past-tense condition在此不是语法题，而是说幸福感可能在经历之后回看时才成立，与happiness in retrospect一致。
exp.rest: childhood无关；不是要求忽略当下情绪，而是不把瞬时快乐当作唯一尺度；也没有说过去的事情总比现在幸福。

q: The revised training course features a workshop in which volunteers repair old bicycles. Here, features most nearly means:
o: includes the workshop as a prominent part of the course
requires every volunteer to buy a new bicycle

exp.trans: 修订后的培训课程把志愿者修理旧自行车的工作坊作为特色内容。features表示把该工作坊作为课程的重要部分。
exp.structure: The revised training course（主语）+ features（谓语）+ a workshop（宾语）。in which volunteers repair old bicycles是修饰workshop的定语从句，来自Volunteers repair old bicycles in the workshop。
exp.other: revised 修订的；training course 培训课程；workshop 工作坊；volunteer 志愿者。
exp.meaning: feature作及物动词表示把某内容作为重要或特色部分，不是名词“外貌特征”。
exp.rest: physical characteristics对应features的名词义，与当前及物动词位置不符；cancels与课程包含工作坊相反；buy a new bicycle没有证据，原句讨论repair old bicycles。

q: After hearing the same melody at lunch for a month, Lina starts humming it without noticing. A researcher calls this a subconscious influence. The influence is subconscious chiefly because:
o: Lina deliberately planned to learn the melody.
Lina is not fully aware of how the repeated melody affects her.
The restaurant is legally required to play music.
The melody has no effect on Lina at all.

exp.trans: 连续一个月午饭时听同一段旋律后，Lina不自觉地开始哼唱。研究者称这是一种潜意识影响，因为她没有充分意识到反复听到的旋律怎样影响自己。
exp.structure: After hearing...是时间背景，其逻辑主语是Lina。主干：Lina + starts humming + it；without noticing表示她没有察觉这一行为。A researcher + calls + this + a subconscious influence是call A B结构。
exp.other: melody 旋律；hum 哼唱；repeated 反复的；be aware of 意识到。
exp.meaning: subconscious强调影响发生在充分自觉意识之下；不等于影响不存在，也不能根据她未察觉来猜测他人的法律义务。
exp.rest: deliberately planned与without noticing描述的未充分自觉相反；legally required无证据；no effect与Lina开始哼唱的行为变化矛盾。
